basis: GAG storage disorder; skeletal, neurologic and valvular damage each affect >30% across common forms. Hearing and airway disease omitted by cap.
Carcinoma arising from intrahepatic bile ducts.
Inherited enzyme deficiency; apnea follows anesthetic exposure and does not establish intrinsic pulmonary damage.
Benign tumor arising in the peritoneal lining of the abdominal digestive compartment; vascular morphology does not imply vascular disease.
Intellectual disability, hypotonia and epilepsy define this neurodevelopmental disorder; isolated skeletal findings occur in 1/4.
Protozoal infection of the cervix; the reproductive site has no anatomical axis.
Developmental delay in 12/13; scoliosis in 4/13 (~31%) supports skeletal involvement. Reflux is a separately diagnosed condition.
Menstrual pain without underlying pelvic pathology; purely reproductive condition.
Localized epithelial hyperplasia and keratinization of the esophagus; adjacent carcinoma is a separate minority association.
Pleural effusion is a defining diagnostic feature. Ovarian tumor has no axis; ascites does not establish intestinal or hepatic damage.
Tuberculous infection directly involves the heart, pericardium or vessels; pulmonary involvement is not required.
Ulceration of the duodenal wall; infection is not intrinsic to every duodenal ulcer.
Vasculopathy, fixed mydriasis and intestinal dysfunction define the syndrome; dysgyria in 12/13 supports neurologic involvement. Urinary involvement omitted by cap.
Dermal defects define disease; supplied HPO reports oral defects 80-99% and neurologic injury 30-79%, although the definition describes isolated skin lesions.
Combined pituitary hormone deficiency; growth failure reflects endocrine dysfunction rather than intrinsic skeletal disease.
Facial bone, dental and tongue overgrowth define the condition. Airway obstruction and hearing loss occur in only 5-29%; septal deviation alone adds no functional damage.
Premature fusion of a cranial suture; neurologic or ocular damage is not established for this isolated subtype.
Inflammation directly affects skeletal muscle. This broad umbrella includes noninfectious, nonautoimmune forms, so inflammation alone does not establish an immune mechanism.
Skeletal muscle channelopathy and ventricular arrhythmias define disease; dental abnormalities occur in 30-79%. Hyperthyroidism is a separate condition.
Inflammation confined to the penile prepuce, a reproductive structure; no infectious or autoimmune mechanism is specified.
Congenital glycosylation disorder; retinal and neurologic manifestations vary by subtype, with no supplied evidence establishing either in >=30% across this umbrella.
Acanthamoeba infection directly damages the cornea and may extend within the eye.
Intellectual disability defines syndrome; myopathy/contractures and cataracts reported in 80-99%, hearing loss in 12/14. Endocrine, blood and other findings omitted by cap.
COL12A1 myopathy with weakness, contractures and joint hypermobility; atrophic scars in 3/5 (~60%) support skin involvement.
Cardiac malformations are major Noonan criteria; keratosis pilaris in 3/5, prolonged prothrombin time in 2/2 and developmental delay in 2/5 support additional axes.
